message:
test(keepalive-r2 A r5, Codex N4): the directory suite writes and deletes only inside a named test root

Codex codex_keepalive_r2_spike_r4.md N4. test/run.js and relay_env_bound_test.js made and removed their
files in os.tmpdir() -- outside the repository. Now:
- test/test_tmp.js: the root is REMOTE60_TEST_TMP, a folder directly under .claude/test-tmp (checked before
  anything is made, and again on the real path). file() and remove() resolve the real path (a link refused)
  and act only inside it. No root set: the suite stops before writing anything.
- run.js: its data file, log and update folders under that root; every child gets REMOTE60_TEST_TMP and
  TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR = the root, so the children that use os.tmpdir() stay inside it too.
- the four scratch-folder tests follow REMOTE60_TEST_TMP when set (else their worktree .claude/test-tmp, as before).
Test code only; no product file changed.
